usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the members and optional comment for a flat (non-nested) resource pool. This path is deprecated — Proxmox recommends using GET /pools/?poolid={poolid} instead, particularly if your environment uses nested pools. Requires Pool.Audit permission on /pool/{poolid}; optionally filter the member list by type (qemu, lxc, or storage) to reduce response size.

examples.summary: Fetch all members of the 'prod-vms' pool

tips: This endpoint is marked deprecated; prefer GET /pools/?poolid={poolid} for future-proof usage and nested pool support.
Use the 'type' query param to limit results to only VMs (qemu), containers (lxc), or storage — useful when you only need one resource class.
The members array includes 'node' and 'id' fields that can be used directly to construct follow-up VM or storage API calls.
openvz appears in the response type enum for legacy compatibility but is not used in current Proxmox VE versions.
